`interface IMsdfSource`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`MsdfSource`](/reference/text/msdfsource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IMsdfSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/source/IMsdfSource.java)

A source that reads one `MsdfFontFace`, from a font file or from anything else.

## Description

Pass one to [`MsdfFontLoader.load`](/reference/text/msdffontloader/#MsdfFontLoader-method-load) in place of a file.
Extend [`MsdfSource`](/reference/text/msdfsource/) rather than implementing this interface, so that `weight(...)` and `italic(...)` work on your source too.

## Method details

<a id="IMsdfSource-method-read"></a>

### read

`MsdfFontFace read()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it on a loader thread, never on the render thread: read the face and return it.
Throw `IOException` when it cannot be read; the future of the loader then completes exceptionally.

<a id="IMsdfSource-method-describe"></a>

### describe

`String describe()` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Returns how the face was read, for the line that dev mode logs after the load; by default the name of the source class.
